invariants.rationale: Post-processing of the write metadata to produce the returned List<WriteStatus> should not produce a null list.
Method uses preppedRecords as input; typical contract is that this should not be null at method exit.
instantTime is an operational parameter for this write operation and should not be null.
If there are no preppedRecords, the write result should also be empty; otherwise, a write should have occurred.
There can't be more write status records than input records; this holds in normal bulk insert execution.
